mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( MO_NUM INT IDENTITY (1,1) NOT NULL, MO_ACCEPTTIME VARCHAR(14), MO_MODIFIED VARCHAR(14), MO_NUMBER VARCHAR(20), MO_SENDER VARCHAR(20), MO_ORGADDR VARCHAR(20), MO_MSG VARCHAR(160), MO_SN INT, MO_NET VARCHAR(10), MO_STATUS VARCHAR(1), MO_REPLY_DATE VARCHAR(14), MO_REPLY_MSG VARCHAR(160), CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY ( MO_NUM ) )

CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( MO_NUMBER VARCHAR(20), ALARM_YN VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT'N', ALARM_DAY_TIME VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT'09:00~18:00', ALARM_DAY_RECEIVERS VARCHAR(200), ALARM_DAY_SENDER VARCHAR(20), ALARM_NIGHT_TIME VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT'18:00~09:00', ALARM_NIGHT_RECEIVERS VARCHAR(200), ALARM_NIGHT_SENDER VARCHAR(20), ALARM_MSG VARCHAR(160), AUTO_REPLY_YN VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT'N', AUTO_REPLY_MSG VARCHAR(160) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( MO_ACCEPTTIME, MO_MODIFIED, MO_NUMBER, MO_SENDER, MO_ORGADDR, MO_MSG, MO_SN, MO_STATUS, MO_NET ) VALUES ( #{parameter.receiveDate}, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(19),GETDATE(),120),'-',''),' ',''),':',''), #{parameter.moNumber}, #{parameter.callback}, #{parameter.sender}, #{parameter.message}, #{parameter.moKey}, #{parameter.status}, #{parameter.telco} )
